text:
emily: hey folks — first day! quick access question: I get a 403 when going to https://console.staging.redwood.ai/ — i tried SSO + mfa and it still blocks me. also need to toggle a feature flag (demo_flag) in staging for a customer demo later today. who owns the staging/admin group? any quick path for temporary access?

jessica: welcome emily! :tada: You need to be in the `staging-admins` or `ff-operators` group. Check the access map: https://intranet.redwood.ai/access-map (internal). For fast access request the JIT flow: https://jit.redwood.ai -> choose `staging-console-admin` and set duration. If it's urgent ping @infra-ops.

matt: i can grant a 3-hour staging admin for demos. @emily — what's your SSO username? i'll add you and confirm.
emily: thanks @matt — username is `emily.redwood`. also— is there a recommended service account path if we need programmatic toggles? our demo script uses curl to flip flags.

ana: small correction — i'm ana (not "nana") :) For programmatic toggles we usually use the `ff-ci-bot` service account (scoped). If you need to do it interactively, the easiest is `redwood-cli` auth flow with the service account: ```bash
redwood auth login --service ff-ci-bot --env staging
redwood ff toggle --flag demo_flag --on --env staging
```
Note toggles are audited and show up in the flag change log. If you don't have service-account access, use the JIT console approach and one of us can do the toggle for you.

infra-bot: JIT request created: #JIT-4521 by emily.redwood for `staging-console-admin` duration 3h. Status: pending approval from infra-approvers.

matt: approved. added `emily.redwood` to `staging-admins` for 3h (expires in ~180m). try console now and ping if anything still 403s. i gave access to Feature Flags panel as well.
emily: confirmed — console loads and i can see `demo_flag` in the FF list. thanks! quick follow-up: where's the canonical list of flag owners? i want to add a rollout note for the demo.
jessica: flags catalog lives at https://flags.redwood.ai/catalog — open the flag, Owners column shows maintainers. if owner missing, ping the product owner listed on the flag page or add a reviewer in the Notes tab. for prod toggles the approval flow is different (requires two approvers).

emily: got it, added a quick rollout note and linked the demo plan. thanks everyone :rocket:
